Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Gravitic Snare (EC13)

ACTION • Roll 3+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Intellect vs Fortitude

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 1 Force Damage. Until the start of your next Turn, it can voluntarily move no more than 2 units in total after this effect is applied, counting normal and granted Movement. This does not limit forced movement or teleportation.

Surge 1: Pull each successfully affected creature 1 unit toward the center of the area, stopping before an illegal space. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Force Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Design note: This is an explicit movement restriction, not an undefined Slowed or Restrained Condition.
system.flavor: A strong, temporary restriction on ordinary movement.
